extracted.intended_audience: people planning to attend Laugh Factory Chicago shows / venue patrons
extracted.subtask_description: Event listing and venue policy summary for Laugh Factory Chicago shows, describing show types, performer lineups, ticketing rules, and house policies attendees must follow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Age restriction
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Most shows are 18+. Attendees should be at least 18 years old; shown repeatedly across event listings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Two-drink minimum
rubrics_metrics.description: 2 drink minimum per person (can be non-alcoholic or alcoholic beverage)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies to the majority of shows; patrons must purchase at least two beverages each (non-alcoholic allowed) while attending.

rubrics_metrics.name: No cash payments accepted / NO CASH in showroom
rubrics_metrics.description: NO CASH PAYMENTS ACCEPTED. / NO CASH in the showroom! Please bring a credit/debit card for purchasing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some listings state 'NO CASH PAYMENTS ACCEPTED' generally; others emphasize 'NO CASH in the showroom.' Bring card(s) for purchases. Variants appear across listings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cash/Venmo exchange for tipping
rubrics_metrics.description: You will be able to exchange cash and Venmo for dollar bills to tip the performers before and during the show.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although venue discourages cash in showroom, there is a mechanism to obtain small bills for tipping via exchange of cash or Venmo at certain shows (noted for brunch/drag show Sashay).

rubrics_metrics.name: General admission / first-come-first-served seating
rubrics_metrics.description: General Admission is based on first come first serve. Seating is first come, first served.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Most shows are general admission; arrive early to secure seats. Some shows explicitly state doors open 60 minutes prior (see door-time rule).

rubrics_metrics.name: Standing room possible / ticket holders may be subject to standing room
rubrics_metrics.description: Ticket holders may be subject to standing room.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even with tickets, seating is not guaranteed; ticket holders should prepare for possible standing-room-only situations.

rubrics_metrics.name: 18% service fee applied to drink tabs
rubrics_metrics.description: 18% service fee will be applied to all drink tabs at payment to be given directly to service staff.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An automatic 18% service fee is added to drink tabs and distributed to service staff; appears on multiple listings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vouchers not redeemable at the door
rubrics_metrics.description: Vouchers are not redeemable at the door.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you have vouchers, they cannot be redeemed at the venue entry; check redemption policy in advance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Doors open 60 minutes prior
rubrics_metrics.description: Doors open 60min prior to start of show.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Several listings specify a 60-minute early door opening time; useful for arrival planning and seating.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open Mic sign-up and selection procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Open Mic: Sign-ups are at 7pm at the Laugh Factory to perform at the 9pm show. Random draw for comics and every night a comic will be selected to perform on a future showcase! No drink minimum.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Open Mic nights have on-site sign-ups at a stated time, use a random draw to determine performers, and may include a selection for a future showcase. Notably, Open Mic nights sometimes waive the two-drink minimum.

rubrics_metrics.name: No refunds (event-specific)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: At least one show (Early Bird Comedy Special) explicitly states no refunds; attendees should assume refund policies may vary by event.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prices, performers, and schedule subject to change
rubrics_metrics.description: Prices, performers, and schedule are subject to change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Event details (lineups, times, prices) are not guaranteed and may change; check for updates before attending.

rubrics_metrics.name: Show content / audience suitability warnings
rubrics_metrics.description: Content descriptions indicate suitability and tone (e.g., 'The Nasty Show' — 'it may get dark. It may get dirty. It may make you question what's appropriate to laugh at in public.'; 'Sashay' — queer comedians and drag artists, interactive brunch with lip sync and prizes; 'Remix Comedy' — comedic musical performances).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listings give explicit content/tone cues and show formats so attendees can choose appropriate nights (e.g., explicit/adult humor, drag/queer brunch, musical comedy, interactive audience participation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Event-specific promotions / entry rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Service Industry Night: bring restaurant check-stub or event invitation for complimentary entry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some nights have special promotions or entry conditions (complimentary entry for service industry workers with proof); policies differ per event and are noted in individual listings.
